prompts.reference:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: standalone SUBJECT REFERENCE INPUT for product migration workflow, not a cover.
Primary request: one square 1:1 professional ecommerce product photo of a beautiful cobalt blue structured leather handbag, complete isolated on pure white seamless studio background. Compact medium trapezoid silhouette, one elegant short top handle visible in full, two tiny gold handle fittings, refined small rectangular gold turn-lock clasp, subtly pebbled leather, no brand or letters. Front view with gentle three-quarter turn so the right side is slightly visible, at handbag level. No long shoulder strap. Bag centered with generous white margins at least 15% and occupies 62% of canvas height including its handle. Soft even studio illumination, natural blue color, clean silhouette, minimal delicate ground shadow that does not obscure edges. No people, hands, other objects, labels, watermark, frames, or collage. Exactly one independent product photo. Opaque white background; this reference will be automatically segmented in the workflow.
prompts.cover:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: RunningHub search-card workflow cover, STRICT portrait aspect ratio 3:4 (for example 1080x1440), one final image.
Primary request: premium elegant Chinese editorial cover for a product migration and masked scene integration workflow.
Text verbatim, large and clear in upper part, preserving both divider characters:
"商品迁移丨"
"FLUX Fill OneReward丨"
"主体替换·场景融合"
Small label verbatim: "设计示意"
Scene: refined warm ivory and walnut interior with a cobalt blue structured leather top-handle handbag on a walnut table, a blurred cream sofa in background. The handbag has compact trapezoid silhouette, subtle pebbled leather, two small gold handle mounts, gold rectangular turn-lock clasp, no logo, no strap. Include a small tasteful inset card showing the same blue bag isolated on white and a thin elegant curved arrow pointing toward the main scene bag to communicate reference subject into a new scene. Keep one main bag fully readable and uncrowded. This is a conceptual design illustration, never present it as a tested output.
Design: warm ivory background, deep navy crisp Chinese typography, restrained blue and brushed-gold accents, polished product photography, realistic shadows, generous white space, no flashy gradients.
Composition safety: all title letters, inset reference and essential handbag body and handle inside upper 72% of canvas. Top/right/left margins at least8%. Bottom25% mostly uncluttered warm cream/soft walnut gradient with no text or essential objects, reserved for RunningHub title/button overlay. Small '设计示意' at about68% height.
Constraints: no people, no hands, no watermarks or branded logos, no fake performance claims, no 4K/16K claims, no before/after quality comparison, no tiny unreadable paragraphs. Exactly one clean cover in true3:4.
prompts.target:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: standalone TARGET SCENE INPUT for a masked product replacement workflow, not a cover.
Primary request: one realistic premium interior product photo, square 1:1. A simple ivory beige medium-size structured leather handbag sits centered on a warm walnut side table in a quiet contemporary living room. The handbag is complete, unobstructed, viewed from front with a slight three-quarter angle, its top handle fully visible. Compact trapezoid silhouette, simple gold clasp, no logo, no lettering, no hanging straps. Behind it a blurred cream sofa and pale plaster wall; warm soft window daylight from the left. The tabletop extends generously around the handbag, with no props touching it and generous clearance above the handle. Handbag occupies 45% of image width and 50% image height, lower-middle central area, suitable for painting a replacement mask around it in a visual editor. Natural contact shadow on tabletop, realistic materials, crisp subject. No people, no hands, no flowers, no overlapping items, no text, no watermark, no collage, no frame. Exactly one complete independent input photo. Opaque RGB appearance.
